facts.text: Döbling links to the S45 S‑Bahn line through Heiligenstadt and the Oberdöbling and Krottenbachstrasse stations.
In the first half of the 19th century breweries appeared in Grinzing, Nussdorf and Oberdöbling, with Nussdorf booming.
The Döblinger Bach once flowed into the Danube Canal at Spittelau, but its water has been diverted and the stream disappeared.
Döbling’s name derives from the Krottenbach lake or from Old Slavic Toplica, meaning 'warm stream'.
A rack railway opened in 1874 from Nussdorf to Kahlenberg, followed in 1898 by the Stadtbahn with stations in Ober‑Döbling, Unterdöbling and Heiligenstadt.
The Gräf & Stift automobile factory in Sievering became one of Vienna’s most important industrial producers in the early 20th century.
